graphql_authorization.semantic_boundary: Require a GraphQL query or mutation to perform an operation beyond the caller's effective permission set; introspection or schema visibility alone is not authorization evidence.

source_map_exposure.semantic_boundary: Require an obtainable source-map or debug artifact that exposes original authored source, internal paths, embedded source content, or comparably sensitive frontend implementation detail; a sourceMappingURL string alone is insufficient.

unsafe_api_consumption.semantic_boundary: Require security-sensitive trust in data or control flow supplied by an external API or remote service, such as cross-host redirects, without re-validating the changed trust boundary. WSTG-INFO-10 is used only to map the third-party/API trust boundary; OWASP API10:2023 defines the vulnerability family. Direct user-controlled SSRF alone belongs to the SSRF family.

websocket_authorization.semantic_boundary: Require a WebSocket channel that accepts or continues privileged/sensitive activity despite an authorization state that would block the equivalent HTTP operation; origin-only failures are not enough for this family.
